question: Which option correctly states the venue and complete schedule of the Yonex-Sunrise India Open 2025, a BWF Super 750 tournament?

options.text: Held at Thyagaraj Stadium, New Delhi, from 10–15 January 2025
Conducted at Siri Fort Sports Complex from 12–17 January 2025
Hosted at K.D. Jadhav Indoor Hall, New Delhi, from 14–19 January 2025
Organised at Talkatora Indoor Stadium from 16–21 January 2025

solution:
The correct answer is __**Hosted at K.D. Jadhav Indoor Hall, New Delhi, from 14–19 January 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yonex-Sunrise India Open 2025:** The tournament will be hosted at **K.D. Jadhav Indoor Hall**, located in **New Delhi**. The event is scheduled from **14–19 January 2025**, which is the correct venue and date combination.
 
• The Yonex-Sunrise India Open is classified as a **BWF Super 750 tournament**, which is part of the **Badminton World Federation (BWF) World Tour.**
 
• The venue, **K.D. Jadhav Indoor Hall**, is a world-class facility located in the capital city of India, New Delhi, and is equipped to host international-level badminton tournaments.
 
• The tournament schedule aligns with the **BWF World Tour calendar**, which includes major badminton events throughout the year.
 
• Participants from various countries compete in singles, doubles, and mixed doubles categories, making it one of the most anticipated events on the badminton calendar.
 
• Option 1 mentions Thyagaraj Stadium in New Delhi from **10–15 January 2025**, but this venue is not the official location for the Yonex-Sunrise India Open 2025. *Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.*
 
• Option 2 refers to the Siri Fort Sports Complex from **12–17 January 2025**. While Siri Fort has hosted badminton tournaments in the past, it is not the official venue for the 2025 edition. *Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.*
 
• Option 4 mentions Talkatora Indoor Stadium from **16–21 January 2025**, but this is also not the venue for the Yonex-Sunrise India Open 2025. *Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.*
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Hosted at K.D. Jadhav Indoor Hall, New Delhi, from 14–19 January 2025.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Yonex-Sunrise India Open:**

 
 
• The Yonex-Sunrise India Open is one of the premier badminton tournaments held annually in India. It is part of the prestigious **BWF World Tour Super 750 series**, attracting top players from around the world.
 
• This tournament serves as a platform for players to earn **BWF ranking points**, which are crucial for qualifying for major events like the Olympics and World Championships.
 
 
 
• **K.D. Jadhav Indoor Hall:**
 
 
• The venue is named after **K.D. Jadhav**, India’s first individual Olympic medalist. It is a state-of-the-art facility located in **New Delhi**.
 
• Equipped with modern amenities and seating capacity for thousands of spectators, the hall has hosted numerous sports events, including wrestling and badminton tournaments.
 
 
 
• **BWF World Tour:**
 
 
• The **BWF World Tour** is a series of elite badminton tournaments organized by the **Badminton World Federation**. It is divided into different levels, including Super 1000, Super 750, Super 500, and so on.
 
• The Super 750 category represents high-ranking tournaments that offer substantial prize money and ranking points.
 
• **India Open** has been upgraded to Super 750 status, reflecting its growing importance in the global badminton circuit.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Participation:**

 
 
• The tournament attracts top-ranked players from countries like **China, Japan, Indonesia, Denmark, and India**. It is an opportunity for players to showcase their skills and compete at the highest level.
 
• Indian players such as **P.V. Sindhu** and **Kidambi Srikanth** have participated in the event, making it a significant event for Indian badminton enthusiasts.
 
 
 
• **Significance for India:**
 
 
• Hosting such high-level tournaments in India boosts the popularity of badminton and encourages young talent to pursue the sport professionally.
 
• It also enhances India’s reputation as a capable host of international sporting events, attracting more tournaments to the country.
